paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.

model_annotations.English: The chart titled “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B Comparison” illustrates accuracy results for two methods, “Vanilla CoT” and “TLDR (Ours),” across four benchmark datasets. The category axis is horizontal and lists the datasets in the order GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, with two side-by-side bars per dataset. The value axis is vertical, labeled “Accuracy (%),” and uses a linear scale spanning 0 to 100 with regularly spaced tick marks at 20-point intervals (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100). For each dataset, the pale yellow bar represents Vanilla CoT and the green bar represents TLDR (Ours), as indicated by the legend at the top. The Vanilla CoT bars have numeric labels above them: GSM8K is 92.5, MATH500 is 86.4, AIME is 43.4, and AMC is 79.6. The TLDR (Ours) green bars are drawn adjacent to each yellow bar and have small percentage annotations above them indicating the change relative to Vanilla CoT: GSM8K shows “−1.6%” (in red) with the green bar slightly below the 92.5 level, MATH500 shows “+0.2%” (in green) with the green bar slightly above 86.4, AIME shows “−0.1%” (in red) with the green bar nearly matching 43.4, and AMC shows “+3.9%” (in green) with the green bar above the 79.6 level. The bars are grouped by dataset rather than sorted by height, and no bars appear additionally emphasized beyond the color coding and the delta annotations.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart titled “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B Comparison” illustrates accuracy results for two methods, “Vanilla CoT” and “TLDR (Ours),” across four benchmark datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categorical dataset labels GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100 with regularly spaced tick marks at 20-point intervals (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100). For each dataset, two adjacent (grouped) vertical bars are shown: a light yellow bar for Vanilla CoT and a green bar for TLDR (Ours), as indicated by the legend near the top. On GSM8K, the Vanilla CoT bar is labeled 92.5%, while the TLDR bar is slightly lower at approximately 90.9% with a red “-1.6%” annotation above it; on MATH500, Vanilla CoT is 86.4% and TLDR is about 86.6% with a green “+0.2%” annotation; on AIME, Vanilla CoT is 43.4% and TLDR is about 43.3% with a red “-0.1%” annotation; and on AMC, Vanilla CoT is 79.6% and TLDR is about 83.5% with a green “+3.9%” annotation. The bars are not displayed as stacked and do not appear to be sorted by value; the only visual emphasis beyond color is the small green/red percentage-change text placed above the TLDR bars.
